description: Land Acquisition - Kotahena, Colombo D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act, specifically detailing the acquisition of multiple land parcels for canal bank maintenance and infrastructure development. It contains detailed descriptions of land lots, their current uses, claimants, and extents, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
